description: Build a self-contained source COMP that ingests an external feed — screen grab, NDI, Syphon/Spout, camera, or a video stream (RTSP/SRT/WebRTC) — normalizes it to a target resolution, and exposes a named Null TOP output ready for the mixer, decks, or post-fx chain. The default 'screen_grab' is zero-permission and safe to test anywhere. 'camera' (Video Device In) is opt-in: it can hang TouchDesigner on a macOS permission modal until the user clicks Allow. NDI, Syphon/Spout, and video_stream are platform- and license-gated (NDI requires the NDI Runtime; Syphon is macOS-only, Spout is Windows-only). Par names for the source/sender/URL are probed defensively so a name that differs between TD builds becomes a warning rather than a hard failure.

kind.description: Source kind. DEFAULT screen_grab — zero-permission, safe to test. 'camera' (Video Device In) can hang TD on a macOS permission modal, so it is opt-in.

name.description: Name for the source system COMP.

resolution.description: Target resolution [w,h] (a Fit/Resolution stage normalizes the feed).

source_name.description: (ndi/syphon_spout) The sender/stream name to receive. (video_stream) the URL (RTSP/SRT/WebRTC). (camera) the device name. Omit for the first available / a sensible default.
